purpose: Remaining ten independently composed 4:3 companions; Galaxy reference created in v5.
processing: Original generated PNG copied unchanged. Unity TextureImporter maxTextureSize=1024, npotScale=None imports 1024x768.

No thick corner masses, no bright white background highlights, no text, numbers, price, labels, UI, watermark, guides, external margins, mockup context or checkerboard. Naturally proportioned forms. One 4:3 namecard filling the entire image.
